answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 29050 Country: India Title: Wht is the dua between two sajdaah? in which namaz we should recite it i.e. farz,sunnat,nafil,witr. reply soon Question: asalamualaikum.... wht is the dua between two sajdaah? in which namaz we should recite it i.e. farz,sunnat,nafil,witr. reply soon Answer ID: 29050 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 140/140/M=1432) The following dua is narrated between the two sajdahs: اللهم اغفرلي ورحمنى و عافنى ، و اهدني و ارزقني . But it is related to nafl i.e. one should recite it in tahajjud etc or even in fardh salah in case of offering it alone. و ما ورد محمول على النفل أى تهجداً أو غيره الخ .(درمختار مع الشامى) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
